ideas.title: Progressive Disclosure in AI Interfaces
ideas.content: Most AI tools dump all capabilities upfront ('I can do X, Y, Z...'). What if interfaces revealed capabilities progressively based on user expertise? Beginners see 3 core actions. Power users unlock advanced features through use.
ideas.content_zh: 大多数 AI 工具一打开就把所有功能堆在你面前。如果界面能根据你的熟练度慢慢展开呢？新手只看到 3 个核心动作，用得多了自然解锁更多。

ideas.title: The 'Undo' Problem for AI Actions
ideas.content: Traditional software: Undo is trivial. AI agents: How do you undo an email sent, a calendar invite accepted, a file deleted? We need new interaction patterns for AI that acts on your behalf. Maybe: preview mode by default, confirmation for irreversible actions.
ideas.content_zh: 传统软件的撤销很简单。但 AI Agent 呢？它帮你发的邮件、接的日历邀请、删的文件，怎么撤？需要新的交互模式。也许：默认预览模式，不可逆的操作必须确认。

ideas.title: AI Confidence as a Design Material
ideas.content: AI systems have varying confidence in their outputs. Most UIs hide this. What if we designed with confidence as a first-class element? High confidence = direct answer. Medium = show alternatives. Low = 'I'm not sure, here's my reasoning.'
ideas.title_zh: AI 置信度作为设计材料
ideas.content_zh: AI 系统对自己的回答有多有少把握，但大多数 UI 把这个信息藏了。如果把置信度当成一等设计元素呢？很确定=直接给答案，有点拿不准=展示备选，不确定=「我不确定，这是我的推理」。

ideas.title: Prompt Engineering as Product Design
ideas.content: Writing prompts isn't just engineering—it's UX design. The prompt shapes user expectations, defines interaction patterns, and sets boundaries. Good prompts: set clear scope, provide examples, allow progressive complexity.
ideas.title_zh: 提示词工程即产品设计
ideas.content_zh: 写提示词不只是工程活，它本质上是 UX 设计。提示词塑造用户期望、定义交互规则、画好边界。好的提示词：范围清晰、带示例、允许渐进变复杂。

ideas.title: Designing for 'AI Surprise'
ideas.content: Sometimes AI outputs surprise us positively (novel insight). Sometimes negatively (hallucination). How do we design systems that maximize good surprise while minimizing bad? Maybe: sandbox mode for exploration, validation layer for production.
ideas.content_zh: AI 的输出有时是好惊喜（新角度），有时是坏惊喜（胡说八道）。怎么让系统多给好的、少给坏的？也许：探索用沙箱模式，生产加验证层。

ideas.title: The Portfolio Problem for AI Products
ideas.content: How do you showcase AI product work when outputs are non-deterministic? Traditional portfolios show 'the design.' AI portfolios need to show: prompt evolution, failure modes, edge cases, how you tuned behavior. New format needed.
ideas.title_zh: AI 产品的作品集难题
ideas.content_zh: AI 产品的输出每次都不一样，作品集该怎么做？传统作品集展示「设计稿」。AI 作品集得展示：提示词迭代过程、失败模式、边缘案例、行为调优怎么做。这个领域需要新格式。

ideas.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration Patterns
ideas.content: Future: Multiple AI agents working together. Design challenge: How do users understand agent relationships? Who's responsible when things go wrong? Potential pattern: Agent 'introduction' flow showing roles and capabilities upfront.
ideas.content_zh: 未来会有多个 AI Agent 一起干活。设计难题：用户怎么理解它们的关系？出了错谁负责？也许可以设计一个 Agent「自我介绍」流程，先让用户知道谁是谁、能做什么。

ideas.title: Voice as the New Wireframe
ideas.content: With AI, you can prototype interactions through conversation before building UI. 'Show me a dashboard for this data' → iterate through voice → only then design visual interface. Voice-first prototyping could be huge for speed.
ideas.content_zh: 有了 AI，可以先用对话原型交互，再做 UI。「给我看这个数据的看板」→ 语音迭代 → 然后才画界面。语音优先原型可能会极大提速。
